heading.title: Security for Keeping the Peace and for Good Behaviour

article.title: Copy of order to accompany summons or warrant
article.content: Every summons or warrant issued under section 132 shall be accompanied by a copy of the order made under section 130, and such copy shall be delivered by the officer serving or executing such summons or warrant to the person served with, or arrested under, the same.
article.html:
133Copy of order to accompany summons or warrant

Section 133 · Chapter IX

Every summons or warrant issued under section 132 shall be accompanied by a copy of the order made under section 130, and such copy shall be delivered by the officer serving or executing such summons or warrant to the person served with, or arrested under, the same.
